candidates.statement: Order service postgres save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool is fully saturated (pool.size=5, idle=0) across all sampled traces, causing /v1/orders 503 and gateway /v1/checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres server-side metrics or pool wait-time data; pool exhaustion inferred from idle=0 and DependencyUnavailable, not directly measured saturation.

report.explanation: Traces show order's postgres save_order failing with DependencyUnavailable and pool idle=0, propagating 503 from /v1/orders and 502 at gateway /v1/checkout. Order metrics confirm 503s on /v1/orders and postgres save_order failures. Deployment record only establishes version facts, not causation.
